double(X, Y) :- Y is X * 2.
choice(a).
choice(b).

:- use_module(library(plunit)).

:- begin_tests(arithmetic).
test(double, true(Y == 6)) :- double(3, Y).
test(choices, all(X == [a, b])) :- choice(X).
test(no_solution, [fail]) :- choice(c).
test(expected_error, [throws(error(type_error(evaluable, _), _))]) :- double(hello, _).
test(work_in_progress, [blocked(todo)]) :- true.
:- end_tests(arithmetic).
